static_leads.note: WAR WEB-INF/jsp/view/people.jsp:55 gives the writableTable no pagesize attribute; displaytag TableTag uses pagesize 0 as no paging, so D37 'paged at the bottom' may not hold. Static only; not a finding.

DataSamplerImpl#getHibernateOperations falls back to getHibernateTemplate() when hibernateOperations is null, so the H205 inference that enabling the flag fails with a null reference is doubtful. Static only; not a finding.

Sampling at iteration start (StartIterationAction#beforeObjectCommit) calls iteration.start() before generateOpeningDataSamples, so the extension rule can apply there; at close the status is set inactive first, so it cannot.
No WAR JSP reads the TimeGenerator; only iteration start/close (history time, samples), sampling and the reminder job use it, so the clock shift is not expected to show on a read-only page.
The manual sampling command samples iterations with status 0 whose dates span today (Metrics.xml IterationToSample) and writes 3 samples per iteration dated tomorrow at midnight.

EditPropertiesAction sets the value in the shared static XPlannerProperties object, read by iteration.jsp:116 and DataSamplerImpl; /do/systemInfo does not list these keys. The per-project option is optEscapeBrackets (attribute xplanner.escape.brackets, source default true); it escapes < and >, not [[...]].
